sample_frame_pairs: sample frame pairs from a FrameRange using multiple sampling strategies like hierarchical or consecutive modes
sample_hierarchical_pairs: generate hierarchical frame pairs with configurable min and max distance between neighboring frames
sample_exhausted_pairs: generate all possible frame pairs exhaustively with optional two-way pairing support
sample_consecutive_pairs: sample consecutive frame pairs by generating adjacent frame pairs with distance one
filter_pairs_to_range: filter a list of frame pairs to only include those within a specified frame range
